release_effect: This manifest bounds a repair set. It does not certify the unaffected passages, does not imply the corpus outside Units 06-10 is clean, and does not authorize quality-field promotion.

repair_waves.name: answer_key_cloze_and_grounding_correctness
repair_waves.reason: These defects directly produce wrong, ungrammatical, ungrounded, or internally mismatched learner answers when the official key is used.

repair_waves.name: systemic_naturalness_and_a1_operationality
repair_waves.reason: These expose systemic failure classes: forced target insertion, unnatural collocation, circular/metalinguistic definition, and A1 tasks that test abstract labels instead of practical use.

repair_waves.name: minor_language_polish_after_structural_repairs
repair_waves.selection_rule: All remaining minor findings in the four source audits, plus any secondary wording changes required by accepted Wave 1/2 repairs.
repair_waves.reason: Minor wording changes must be applied after structural repairs so exposure counts and checkpoint language are recalculated once rather than repeatedly.

systemic_search_classes.search_goal: Find every cloze where inserting the keyed answer yields wrong agreement, case, order, or an unnatural sentence.
Find cumulative/multi-blank items whose answer list order does not correspond to blank order.
Compare each Unit checkpoint against its source passages for newly introduced grammatical, semantic, or grounding defects.
Find target/review vocabulary inserted into semantically possible but non-idiomatic contexts solely to preserve exposure counts.
Find A1 questions asking learners to describe grammatical/semantic functions abstractly when an operational use/context task is available.
Check oblique case, ko-marking, adjective-noun gender agreement, and possessive agreement across learner-facing text and explanations.
Find definitions that repeat the target, define it with the same concept circularly, or contain language harder/less natural than the target itself.

edit_guardrails: Do not edit passages outside the exact IDs implicated by a source finding unless a corpus-wide search confirms the same defect class there and a new finding is recorded first.
Do not change quality.status or any pending review field merely because a repair was applied.
Preserve target IDs unless the intended sense itself is rejected; if a target is rescheduled, update introduction/review chronology explicitly.
Any learner-facing text change invalidates exact exposure counts for affected targets and requires recounting.
Checkpoint repairs must be validated separately from their source passages.
All keyed clozes must be mechanically reconstructed with their official answers and read as complete sentences during regression testing.
required_regression_after_each_wave: mechanical keyed-answer insertion for every cloze
review target chronology and expected exposure numbers
fresh manual adversarial read of every changed passage
next_scope_after_repair_manifest: Continue semantic pass 1 over Urdu A1 Units 01-05, then run the seven systemic search classes over all 60 A1 passages before any educator-ready claim.
